Her black hair is in a semi-updo with loose strands, a slight night breeze, and restrained white floral, pearl, or jade hair ornaments. The action is serving tea, with correctly proportioned spout, handle, cup mouth, natural liquid direction, slender natural fingers, and an elegant gentle gesture. The overall composition is balanced and minimalist, with the dense dark charcoal mass of the figure anchoring the centre while the sparse text elements float in the negative space on either side, creating a quiet, contemplative mood on a restrained palette of black ink on cream paper.
